## Description of change
Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed. Please also include relevant motivation and context.

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Refactor (code improvement without functional changes)
- [ ] Docs (documentation updates)
- [ ] Other (please specify):

## Checklist
- [ ] I have run `gofmt -l .` and confirmed no formatting issues.
- [ ] I have run `go vet ./...` and fixed any issues.
- [ ] I have run `go test ./...` and all tests passed.
- [ ] I have validated the configuration changes (if any).

## Impact on root/cgroup/Docker/systemd
- Does this change affect root privileges? (Yes/No)
- Does this change affect cgroup v2 configuration? (Yes/No)
- Does this change affect Docker runtime integration? (Yes/No)
- Does this change affect systemd service units? (Yes/No)

**Details:**
Please provide details if any of the above are "Yes".
